title: Project Task Listing
purpose: List projects and their tasks with the current project manager, client and task billing code, for the weekly project review and billing-code setup checks.

lov.name: LOV_PROJECT_NUMBER
lov.description: Non-template project numbers, cascaded on selected business units

lov.name: LOV_PROJECT_STATUS
lov.description: Display = status name, value = status code

parameters.name: Project Manager
parameters.label: Project Manager

lov.name: LOV_PROJECT_MANAGER
lov.description: Display = person name, value = person ID as text

parameters.notes: LOV returns person_id as text; compare with TO_CHAR(person_id) (C-03).

columns.source_hint: Status as shown on the project
Client contact on the project's Parties tab

filters.description: Chargeable Tasks Only = Y restricts to chargeable tasks

business_rules.description: Show only the current project manager; if several, the most recent (latest start date).
Client name from the client contact on the project's Parties tab; blank when none is assigned.
Billing code from the task-level DFF segment (environment-specific mapping).

security.notes: Report-level access only. BIP SQL does not apply Fusion PPM data security automatically.

assumptions.text: Projects with no tasks are excluded (inner join to tasks).
assumptions.reason: Grain is one row per task and the sample output shows only task rows. Confirm via Q-1.

assumptions.text: 'Active projects' (rule 4) is NOT hard-coded; the Project Status parameter controls status.
assumptions.reason: Hard-coding would conflict with the multi-select status parameter. Confirm via Q-2.

assumptions.text: 'Current' project manager = party assignment active on the run date (SYSDATE).
assumptions.reason: FSD has no as-of date parameter.

assumptions.text: Project Status displays the translated status name; the parameter filters on status code.
Billing Code = PJF_TASKS_V.ATTRIBUTE1, Global Data Elements context (no ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY filter).
assumptions.reason: Stated in configuration docs: sample-ppm-dff-configuration.md > 1. Project Task Descriptive Flexfield; ATTRIBUTE1 confirmed on PJF_TASKS_V by Oracle Docs 26A. Was open question Q-3.

open_questions.question: Should projects with no tasks appear (with blank task columns)?
open_questions.impact: Inner vs left join to tasks; row counts.

open_questions.question: Rule 4 says 'active projects' but Project Status is a parameter. Should the default be 'Active' only, or all statuses?
open_questions.impact: Default parameter value and row counts.

open_questions.question: Should users only see projects in BUs they have access to (data security)?
open_questions.impact: BIP SQL does not apply Fusion data security; would need a security join.

open_questions.question: Client Name: should it show the client contact person, or the client organization the contact belongs to?
open_questions.impact: Join from PJF_PROJECT_PARTIES.RESOURCE_SOURCE_ID to HZ_PARTIES may return the contact person; the organization needs an HZ_RELATIONSHIPS hop.
